name: Grand Hotel Stockholm
positioning: Grand Hôtel, a five star waterfront hotel in Stockholm opened in 1874, facing the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan
best_for: Travelers who want a historic waterfront base facing the Royal Palace and the old town
Food and wine lovers drawn to Swedish smörgåsbord, a deep wine cellar and a champagne bar

facts.text: The Grand Hôtel has hosted guests and events in Stockholm since 1874.
Régis Cadier opened the hotel in 1874.
The hotel sits on the waterfront and overlooks the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan, Stockholm's old town.
The Veranda restaurant is known for its traditional Swedish smörgåsbord.
The Veranda serves lunch and dinner with a view over the water and the palace.
Grand Soleil serves a menu drawn from the French and Italian Riviera.
The champagne bar beside the lobby pours a wide range of producers and vintages by the glass.
Room service is available around the clock.
The spa offers classic Swedish massage, beauty treatments, personal trainers, a doctor of traditional Chinese medicine and a chiropractor.
The wine cellar's 2,500 labels focus on Europe's classic wine regions.
The wine cellar can host private dinners for up to 8 guests.

highlights.text: The wine cellar holds Mouton-Rothschild from the hotel's opening year, 1874, and Pol Roger from the 1914 champagne vintage.
The Cadier Bar is named after Régis Cadier, a French chef and the hotel's founder.
The Veranda's buffets and smörgåsbord are served with the hotel's own snaps, Grand Hôtel Akvavit.
The spa takes its inspiration from the sea and the islands and nature of the Stockholm archipelago.
The concierge can book everything from restaurant tables and theater tickets to helicopter tours.

considerations.text: The spa has a minimum age of 16.
The Veranda has a smart casual dress code.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
